div.p: Each layer catches what the others miss. Static analysis runs 200+ patterns in milliseconds. Symbolic execution explores every path. AI reasoning finds the logic flaws that rules can't.
Pattern matching, control flow, data flow tracking. 200+ vulnerability signatures across 5 languages.
Explores all execution paths to surface state-dependent bugs, edge cases, and constraint violations.
LLM-powered analysis for business logic flaws, novel attack patterns, and intent-vs-implementation gaps.

div.p: Code encrypted in transit and at rest, processed in isolation, never retained.

New vulnerabilities are discovered daily. AuditBase continuously re-analyzes your deployed contracts against new patterns and alerts you when something changes — so a point-in-time audit never goes stale.
